QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` must be defined (it is on by default, `mbedtls_config.h:52`). The compiler must define `__GNUC__`. Clang counts; MSVC does not. ... If any of these fails, `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` stays undefined and the C path is used."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is derived from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros such as `__GNUC__`, and that it stays undefined when the guard fails. It never says outright that the macro is not set in mbedtls_config.h, but the derivation is clearly described.
